popup.japan.countContractValue: Counts only canonical entities that can be drawn; OSM coverage is not layered on, and records without geometry are not added.
popup.japan.classUnclassified: Source gives no consistent subtype and no name rule matched
popup.japan.sourceOperatorValue: {value} (original source value; not verified as a company or operator)
popup.japan.sourceIdentityValue: {value} (valid only within this source/version; not a cross-source entity ID)
popup.japan.qualityRegistryNote: This layer is a registry of monitoring sites and contains no water quality concentrations or trends.
popup.japan.groundwaterLimit: Covers only 24 prefectures; the year is not provided, and an empty view does not mean there is no data nationwide.
popup.japan.nilimLimit: Covers 46 prefectures; the year is not provided, and it is independent of the KSJ dams, so the two cannot be added directly.
popup.japan.maffLimit: The datum of the MAFF source is unknown, so positions are candidates only; 4,284 rows sharing the same coordinates are kept and have not been merged.
popup.japan.approxPositionValue: The address was resolved only to chome/town level, so this is not the exact facility position
popup.japan.evacSameAddressValue: The same address also hosts the other type of designated site
popup.japan.evacLegalNote: The two site types have different legal meanings and must not be added together
popup.japan.evacStaleNote: This data may be out of date. Please confirm with the municipality.
popup.japan.officeBasisNote: Data as of 2022-04; later mergers and closures are not reflected
popup.japan.busScopeNote: 2022 edition; excludes demand-responsive and expressway buses
popup.japan.landslideAccuracyNote: Approximate position (about 1:25,000–1:50,000), not a legal map; does not cover every designated area in the prefecture; not for real-estate disclosure or applications
popup.japan.landslideNestedNote: Special warning (red) zones lie inside warning (yellow) zones; do not add counts or areas
popup.japan.inlandFloodNote: Covers only 28 municipalities; no data does not mean no inland flood risk; a different layer from river flooding (flood inundation assumption)
popup.japan.zoningNote: For reference only; boundaries are approximate and may not be current; not for building confirmation applications or real-estate disclosure; blank ratios mean not recorded in the source, not 0
popup.japan.forestProtectedBlank: Not stated (undisclosed reserves are blank; this does not mean it is not a reserve)
popup.japan.forestScopeNote: National forests only; private forests are not included, and blank areas do not mean no forest
popup.japan.forestMergedNote: This polygon merges adjacent sub-compartments with the same office, forest name, function type, protection forest and reserve; it is not a sub-compartment; protection forest and reserve names are the original Japanese terms
